label: Big words behind you
description: One or two big words drawn behind the speaker: the speaker is cut out of the footage and stays in front of them, through zooms too. Uses params.text, or the spoken words of the anchor. Without the cut-out (the model can't be downloaded), the words go above the head as text-pop and the render says so.

text.help: the words to show; default = the anchor's spoken words

size.help: font size as a fraction of frame width (shrinks to fit)
